exposure: maternal serum levels of cathepsin B
cohort: The cohort consisted of 78 pregnant women diagnosed with preeclampsia and 78 healthy pregnant women, all in their second trimester and aged between 18 and 45 years.
finding: Maternal serum levels of pentraxin 3 and cathepsin B were significantly elevated in pregnancies with preeclampsia compared to healthy pregnancies, and further elevated in severe preeclampsia compared to mild preeclampsia.
